title: A countable metric space whose Hoare power space is not co-sober
summary: Xu asked whether the Hoare power space of a co-sober space, and in particular of a $T_2$-space or a metric space, must be co-sober. We give a negative answer. He and Zhao recently constructed a countable $T_{1}$ space $X$ whose lattice of open sets has a non-sober Scott topology. We observe that their topology has a countable subbase. The classical Ponomarev construction then yields an open continuous surjection from a countable zero-dimensional metrizable space $M$ onto $X$.
